districts.name: Farm District
districts.description: Closed fields under lamp and glass, worked by farmers who keep the colony fed.

districts.name: Civilian District
districts.description: Homes, halls and gardens for a thousand residents, kept livable by its stewards.

districts.name: Research District
districts.description: Quiet halls where researchers add what they learn to humanity's shared understanding.

districts.name: Defense District
districts.description: Sentinel batteries under a hardened crust, crewed by gunners who shoot down census probes and keep the colony quiet.
